sci.phys.light.reflection.plane.title: Reflection from a plane mirror
sci.phys.light.reflection.plane.description: A plane mirror reflects light and changes its direction.

sci.phys.light.image.plane.title: Image formation by a plane mirror
sci.phys.light.image.plane.description: A plane mirror forms an image that appears behind the mirror.

sci.phys.light.mirrors.combination.title: Combination of plane mirrors
sci.phys.light.mirrors.combination.description: Two or more plane mirrors can produce multiple images.
